headline: I can take more pain than the other guy, and I will prove it.
intro: Just for us. One short video a day from people who didn't quit when it got hard. Let's not quit either.

headline: I wish upon you ample doses of pain and suffering.
intro: A little something for the three of us every day. Someone who went through hell and still made it. Let's carry one thing from it into today.

headline: If you are starting a company, work every waking hour.
who: Elon Musk, on what super hard actually means
intro: Our one minute of fuel for the day. Somebody who made it, talking about what it really took.

headline: Luck is a misnomer. There is only hard work.
intro: Nobody we look up to got there on luck. Here's one of them saying it out loud.

headline: Rejected 30 times, even by KFC. He built Alibaba anyway.
intro: Everyone in these videos heard no a lot more than yes. Today's is a reminder that no is not the end.

headline: Do something that sucks every single day.
intro: One minute, one person, one hard truth. Let's take it with us today.

headline: If you have not found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
intro: The people we admire were scared too. They just moved anyway. So can we.

headline: From zero points to the best player in the state in two years.
intro: Another day, another reminder that the work is the shortcut.

headline: Don't become a philosopher before you become rich.
who: Shah Rukh Khan, University of Edinburgh
intro: Today's one is about doing it before you feel ready. Let's do one thing like that today.

headline: Anything great is never easy to build.
intro: Ten days in and we're still showing up. That's the whole game.

headline: His heroes doubted him on TV. He still did not quit.
intro: It looked easy from the outside. It never was. Here's what it actually took.

headline: The best brains of the nation may be on the last benches.
intro: Talent opens the door. Showing up every day keeps it open.

headline: Visit your suffering one hour a day.
intro: Today's dose of someone choosing the hard thing on purpose. Let's pick one hard thing too.

headline: At 80, you won't regret trying. You will regret never trying.
who: Jeff Bezos, on leaving Wall Street to start Amazon
intro: Nobody is coming to do it for us. Good news is, people like this prove it can be done.

headline: Are you going to back off, or crush through it?
intro: One more story of someone who kept going when it made no sense to. Let's be that stubborn.

headline: Opportunity always lies where people complain.
intro: Most of the good stuff is on the other side of boring, repeated work. Today's one gets that.

headline: It doesn't matter how hard you work. I am willing to work harder.
intro: Watch this one before the day gets loud.

headline: Life was made up by people no smarter than you.
intro: They were nobodies once too. Worth remembering when we feel small.

headline: There is no alternative to hard work.
intro: Short one today. Big idea. Let's sit with it for a minute.

headline: Two weeks after 100 miles on broken legs, he qualified for Boston.
who: David Goggins on the Joe Rogan Experience
intro: Twenty days. Twenty people who refused to quit. We're not quitting either.

headline: Every trait you want has a price tag. Are you paying it?
intro: Discipline is just keeping promises to yourself. Here's someone who kept a lot of them.

headline: Rejected as a pilot. Decades later, he flew a fighter jet as President.
intro: Every setback in these stories turned into the turning point. Maybe ours will too.

headline: You can only connect the dots looking backwards.
intro: If today feels heavy, this one's for that.

headline: My new normal: wake up and suffer.
intro: The difference is rarely brains. It's who stays in the game longest.

headline: Believe in what you are doing. Love it. Keep it simple.
intro: Halfway there. Let's finish what we started.

headline: He doesn't start counting until it hurts.
intro: Pain now, pride later. That's the trade every person in this series made.

headline: Our greatest mistake: we let it be called the cheapest car.
intro: Even the legends got it wrong sometimes. What mattered is what they did next.

headline: You get knocked down, you get back up.
who: A Navy SEAL, on serving with David Goggins
intro: Today's reminder: get knocked down, get back up. That's it. That's the plan.

headline: Pain motivates faster than passion.
intro: Comfort is nice. It just never built anything. Here's someone who chose otherwise.

headline: Be quiet. Work hard. With dignity.
who: Shah Rukh Khan, after the toughest years of his career
intro: Thirty days of this. Let's notice if we're thinking a little differently now.

headline: We never give up. We keep changing ourselves. We don't complain.
intro: Keep it simple: do the work, don't complain, keep going. Today's story is exactly that.

headline: He returned Coke bottles to buy food. And he loved it.
intro: Some of the best chapters start broke and unsure. Worth remembering on the slow days.

headline: Vertically integrate or die.
who: Elon Musk, on the early Tesla days
intro: One minute with someone who bet everything on themselves.

headline: Remembering you will die is the best tool for big choices.
intro: Whatever we're putting off today, this one is the push to start it.

headline: Pain is just a signal that you are alive.
intro: Hard days are part of the deal. Here's someone who made peace with that.

headline: Get up early and you can accomplish much more.
intro: Early mornings, extra reps, no excuses. Let's borrow a bit of that today.

headline: Success comes from long periods of suffering.
intro: Small daily effort, done for years, looks like magic from the outside. Here's the proof.

headline: Nobody believed he could be successful.
intro: They believed before anyone else did. Sometimes that's all it takes to start.

headline: On the other side of suffering is a world very few have seen.
intro: The people who win usually just suffered a bit longer than everyone else. Let's last.

headline: I would have to be dead or completely incapacitated.
who: Elon Musk, on ever quitting SpaceX
intro: Forty days. Let's not slow down now.

headline: Getting fired from Apple was the best thing that ever happened to me.
intro: Getting knocked off course isn't the end of the story. Sometimes it's the best part.

headline: I don't ever give up.
who: David Goggins, Elon Musk and Cristiano Ronaldo
intro: No shortcuts in any of these stories. Not one.

headline: Your time is limited. Don't waste it living someone else's life.
intro: We only get so many days. Let's not waste this one living someone else's plan.

headline: Most regrets are things we didn't do.
intro: Regret hurts more than failing ever will. Let's try the thing.

headline: Tomorrow is new. Make the move.
intro: Tomorrow is a fresh start, but today still counts. Let's make a move.

headline: Every morning at five, he practiced English with strangers.
intro: Consistency beats intensity. Today's story is someone who showed up every single day.

headline: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
intro: Stay hungry. That's the whole message today.

headline: My boss said it was a great idea, for someone without a good job.
intro: Somebody once called a great idea a bad one. Let's not let that stop us.

headline: My edge was simple. I never went partying.
intro: The edge is usually something boring that nobody else wants to do. Today's one shows it.

headline: Drink with me tonight. I am banging on your door at 5 AM.
intro: Day 50. We made it, all three of us. Let's keep going.
